title: Celestin's band: road year and personnel
summary: After six or seven months the Smith band broke up; he spends a year on the road with Celestin, replacing Kimball, and names the players.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: How long did you stay with that?

Well, we stayed with Mamet about six or seven months. And the band broke up and came on back home. And then I went with Celestan's band. I stayed on the road with Celestan's band about a year. Who did Celestan live then? Well, Bill Matthews was on the trombone. John Poodle was on the bass. Anderson, uh, Anderson's, what's his name? Andy Anderson. Andy Anderson playing trumpet. Holloway was on the trumpet. And, uh, we had that boy from Tuy. From what? I think he's from around, uh, around the home or somewhere. Trumpet. No, Anderson, Holloway, and Celestan. That's right. That's the three, Celestan. Oh, that's three of them.
Yeah. And I had taken Kimball's place.
That was during, right during the Depression time. The mailman. No, that's right. The mailman. That's the time when he went on the PWA I had taken his place.
He played over the, across the street from us the other night.
First time I guess I heard him play him. I might have heard him before, I'm not sure.
Yeah, it was good banjo player. He played bass too. Yeah, he played bass and banjo.
And John Porter was on the piano.

The sousaphone, yes. Mm-hmm. And, uh, we had a K2 on the piano. And, uh, there were two drummers at that time who was with the band. Was that a big K2? Yeah, no, Lil K2. He was in California now. And, uh, had Lil Gord at one time in Lawrence. I don't know if they were both named, but they were playing drums. Each one of them taking the place during the time when I was in the band. Oh. Well, at that time I had switched over to guitar then. The Chinese had left already. Oh yeah, the Chinese had left.
Yeah, so there's a new bunch. And, uh, where did you, did you all travel? A good deal.
I know you usually travel a lot. Yeah, we did a lot of traveling. And went all around Florida, Alabama, Mississippi, Arkansas, Texas.
